summary: Evidence producers (evidence-publish, ci-evidence-observe, evidence-wrap and so st-test --push) file every record as a tag, refs/tags/evidence/<tree>/<record> (and refs/tags/evidence/input/<check>/<key>/<record> for an input key), as well as the note naming the same commit; evidence-gc reads, keeps and deletes both names together and counts a record once against its soft limit and cap.

replay.detail: CI evidence refs only; the records and their signatures are unchanged, each gains a second name.

schema.detail: CI evidence refs only; the records and their signatures are unchanged, each gains a second name.

rules.detail: Every reader on main already reads tags first; gates on older bases still find the note.

compatibility.detail: Notes are still written, so a gate whose base predates the tag readers decides as before.

recovery.detail: Reverting stops writing tags; the notes written alongside them still carry every record.
